It also provides information  according to health status (asymptomatic, mild, severe, critical) of active cases, whether admitted or not admitted to hospitals/medical facilities, and categorization by sex.  These are mapped using GIS based on the DOH COVID-19 Data Drop Case Information in CSV format RELEASED AS OF 4PM (1600 HRS) AND AS OF INDICATED DATE.   Information aggregated at the national level are taken from the fields  RemovalType, HealthStatus, Admitted, and Sex from the DOH COVID-19 database.

08 COVID-19 Provincial Status as of 2020-05-24
tags: This dataset shows the total number of cases categorized as active, recovered, and died in the affected provinces in  Philippines.  It also provides information  according to health status (asymptomatic, mild, severe, critical) of active cases, whether admitted or not admitted to hospitals/medical facilities, and categorization by sex.  These are mapped using GIS based on the DOH COVID-19 Data Drop Case Information in CSV format RELEASED AS OF 4PM (1600 HRS) AND AS OF INDICATED DATE.   Information aggregated at the provincial level are taken from the fields  RemovalType, HealthStatus, Admitted, and Sex from the DOH COVID-19 database.  NOTE: ANY DISCREPANCY IN THE TOTAL NUMBER OF COVID-19 CASES BETWEEN THE GEOPORTAL MAP AND THE DOH DASHBOARD REPORT IS DUE TO THE CASES THAT COULD NOT BE ATTRIBUTED TO ANY LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNIT (LGU) AS OF REPORT DATE. THE PLACES OF RESIDENCE OF THE COVID-19 CASES ARE STILL SUBJECT TO VALIDATION BY DOH.

tags: This dataset shows the total number of cases categorized as active, recovered, and died in the affected provinces in  Philippines.  It also provides information  according to health status (asymptomatic, mild, severe, critical) of active cases, whether admitted or not admitted to hospitals/medical facilities, and categorization by sex.  These are mapped using GIS based on the DOH COVID-19 Data Drop Case Information in CSV format RELEASED AS OF 4PM (1600 HRS) AND AS OF INDICATED DATE.   Information aggregated at the provincial level are taken from the fields  RemovalType, HealthStatus, Admitted, and Sex from the DOH COVID-19 database.  NOTE: ANY DISCREPANCY IN THE TOTAL NUMBER OF COVID-19 CASES BETWEEN THE GEOPORTAL MAP AND THE DOH DASHBOARD REPORT IS DUE TO THE CASES THAT COULD NOT BE ATTRIBUTED TO ANY LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNIT (LGU) AS OF REPORT DATE. THE PLACES OF RESIDENCE OF THE COVID-19 CASES ARE STILL SUBJECT TO VALIDATION BY DOH.

tags: This dataset shows the total number of cases and the total number of active cases in each affected province in the Philippines. These are mapped using GIS based on the DOH COVID-19 Data Drop Case Information in CSV format RELEASED AS OF 4PM (1600 HRS) AND AS OF INDICATED DATE. NOTE: ANY DISCREPANCY IN THE TOTAL NUMBER OF COVID-19 CASES BETWEEN THE GEOPORTAL MAP AND THE DOH DASHBOARD REPORT IS DUE TO THE CASES THAT COULD NOT BE ATTRIBUTED TO ANY LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNIT (LGU) AS OF REPORT DATE. tags: This dataset shows the total number of cases and the total number of active cases in each affected province in the Philippines. These are mapped using GIS based on the DOH COVID-19 Data Drop Case Information in CSV format RELEASED AS OF 4PM (1600 HRS) AND AS OF INDICATED DATE.  Information aggregated at the provincial level are taken from the fields  RemovalType, HealthStatus, Admitted, Sex,  and AgeGroup from the DOH COVID-19 database.  NOTE: ANY DISCREPANCY IN THE TOTAL NUMBER OF COVID-19 CASES BETWEEN THE GEOPORTAL MAP AND THE DOH DASHBOARD REPORT IS DUE TO THE CASES THAT COULD NOT BE ATTRIBUTED TO ANY LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNIT (LGU) AS OF REPORT DATE. THE PLACES OF RESIDENCE OF THE COVID-19 CASES ARE STILL SUBJECT TO VALIDATION BY DOH.
